definition_en: drive parameter defining how quickly speed decreases
definition_es: parámetro del drive que define qué tan rápido disminuye la velocidad
example_en: Adjust the deceleration time according to the application.

definition_en: drive function used to reduce motor speed or stop a load
definition_es: función del drive usada para reducir velocidad o detener una carga
example_en: Verify the braking settings after drive maintenance.

definition_en: motor current associated with rated full-load operation
definition_es: corriente del motor asociada con operación nominal a plena carga
example_en: Compare measured current with the motor full-load current.

definition_en: motor insulation thermal classification identified on nameplate data
definition_es: clasificación térmica del aislamiento del motor indicada en placa
example_en: Verify the insulation class before replacement.

definition_en: nameplate description of the operating duty for which equipment is designed
definition_es: descripción de placa del régimen de operación del equipo
example_en: Check the motor duty rating for the application.

definition_en: induction motor with a rotor formed by conductive bars shorted by end rings
definition_es: motor de inducción con rotor formado por barras conductoras cortocircuitadas
example_en: The three-phase load uses a squirrel-cage motor.

definition_en: induction motor with accessible rotor windings, typically through slip rings
definition_es: motor de inducción con devanados de rotor accesibles mediante anillos
example_en: Identify the wound-rotor motor before maintenance.

definition_en: condition of shafts or coupled equipment being positioned on the required common axis
definition_es: condición de ejes/equipos acoplados posicionados en el eje requerido
example_en: Check motor-to-load alignment after installation.

definition_en: initial or accepted test result used for future maintenance comparison
definition_es: resultado inicial o aceptado usado como referencia para mantenimiento futuro
example_en: Compare vibration with the baseline test.

definition_en: fixed industrial equipment used to move material or products
definition_es: equipo industrial fijo usado para mover materiales o productos
example_en: Troubleshoot the conveyor control using the drawings and test results.

definition_en: signalling system used to detect and indicate fire-related conditions
definition_es: sistema de señalización usado para detectar e indicar condiciones de incendio
example_en: Test the fire alarm system according to the maintenance schedule.

definition_en: device or interface that displays alarm or system status indications
definition_es: dispositivo o interfaz que muestra alarmas o estados del sistema
example_en: Check the annunciator for the reported alarm condition.

definition_en: security system using devices such as cameras and monitoring equipment
definition_es: sistema de seguridad que usa cámaras y equipos de monitoreo
example_en: Verify the surveillance system after component replacement.

term_es: reflectómetro en el dominio del tiempo
definition_en: test instrument used to locate faults or impedance changes in metallic communication cabling
definition_es: instrumento usado para localizar fallas o cambios de impedancia en cableado metálico
example_en: Use a TDR to help locate the cable fault.

term_es: reflectómetro óptico en el dominio del tiempo
definition_en: fiber-optic test instrument used to characterize and locate events or faults along a fiber link
definition_es: instrumento de fibra óptica usado para caracterizar y localizar eventos o fallas
example_en: Use an OTDR to evaluate the fibre link.

definition_en: tester used to verify conductor pair/pin continuity and wiring arrangement
definition_es: probador usado para verificar continuidad y correspondencia de conductores/pines
example_en: Use the wire map tester on the communication cable.

definition_en: component that intentionally reduces signal level
definition_es: componente que reduce intencionalmente el nivel de señal
example_en: Check the attenuator in the communication path.

definition_en: component used to properly terminate a communication transmission path
definition_es: componente usado para terminar correctamente una línea de transmisión
example_en: Verify the terminator is installed as required.

definition_en: radio-frequency identification technology used to identify tagged objects
definition_es: tecnología de identificación por radiofrecuencia
example_en: RFID tags are listed among communication-system components.

definition_en: digital control method commonly used in building automation
definition_es: método de control digital común en automatización de edificios
example_en: The building automation system uses direct digital control.

definition_en: technology that supplies electrical power and data over Ethernet cabling
definition_es: tecnología que suministra energía y datos por cable Ethernet
example_en: The PoE switch supplies the network device.

definition_en: device that positions an HVAC air damper
definition_es: dispositivo que posiciona una compuerta de aire HVAC
example_en: Command the damper actuator from the building automation system.

definition_en: visual interface used to monitor and control a system
definition_es: interfaz visual usada para monitorear y controlar un sistema
example_en: Check the alarm on the graphical user interface.

definition_en: input representing a limited-state condition such as on/off
definition_es: entrada que representa estados limitados como encendido/apagado
example_en: Map the discrete input to the controller address.

definition_en: output commanding a limited-state device such as on/off
definition_es: salida que ordena estados limitados como encendido/apagado
example_en: Test the discrete output to the solenoid.

definition_en: input representing a continuously varying process signal
definition_es: entrada que representa una señal de proceso variable continuamente
example_en: Trend the analog input to evaluate signal integrity.

definition_en: output representing a continuously variable command signal
definition_es: salida que representa una señal de comando variable continuamente
example_en: Verify the analog output to the proportional valve.

definition_en: measurement or calibration condition recorded before adjustment
definition_es: medición o condición registrada antes del ajuste
example_en: Record the as-found value before calibration.

definition_en: measurement or calibration condition recorded after adjustment
definition_es: medición o condición registrada después del ajuste
example_en: Record the as-left value after calibration.

definition_en: time-based record used to evaluate how a process signal changes
definition_es: registro temporal usado para evaluar cambios de una señal de proceso
example_en: Review the signal trend for intermittent drift.

definition_en: industrial controller that executes programmed control logic
definition_es: controlador industrial que ejecuta lógica programada
example_en: Map the field I/O to the Programmable Logic Controller.

term_es: control supervisorio y adquisición de datos
definition_en: system used for supervisory monitoring, control and data acquisition
definition_es: sistema usado para supervisión, control y adquisición de datos
example_en: The SCADA system displays process status and alarms.

definition_en: control architecture in which control functions are distributed across system controllers
definition_es: arquitectura donde funciones de control se distribuyen entre controladores
example_en: The DCS handles several process-control loops.

definition_en: assignment of physical or logical I/O points to controller addresses or variables
definition_es: asignación de puntos I/O a direcciones o variables del controlador
example_en: Complete the I/O mapping before programming the sequence.

definition_en: program variable associated with a controller memory or I/O address
definition_es: variable asociada con una dirección de memoria o I/O
example_en: Set the address variable for the new input.

definition_en: saved copy of control-system program/configuration used for recovery and documentation
definition_es: copia guardada del programa/configuración para recuperación y documentación
example_en: Create a program backup after verified changes.

definition_en: feedback control loop using proportional, integral and derivative actions
definition_es: lazo de control con acciones proporcional, integral y derivativa
example_en: Tune the PID loop to meet the process requirement.

definition_en: industrial data communication system listed for automated controls
definition_es: sistema de comunicación industrial listado para controles automatizados
example_en: Fieldbus is one communication option listed in the RSOS.

definition_en: industrial network listed among automated-control communication systems
definition_es: red industrial listada entre sistemas de comunicación de control
example_en: DeviceNet is listed among automated control communications.

definition_en: clean compressed air used to operate pneumatic instrumentation and controls
definition_es: aire comprimido limpio usado para instrumentación y controles neumáticos
example_en: Check the instrument-air supply during pneumatic troubleshooting.

definition_en: component used to remove moisture from compressed instrument air
definition_es: componente usado para eliminar humedad del aire comprimido
example_en: Inspect the air dryer during pneumatic maintenance.

definition_en: storage vessel used in pneumatic or hydraulic systems
definition_es: recipiente de almacenamiento usado en sistemas neumáticos o hidráulicos
example_en: Check the reservoir condition and level as applicable.

definition_en: hydraulic component that stores energy using pressurized fluid
definition_es: componente hidráulico que almacena energía mediante fluido presurizado
example_en: Inspect the accumulator according to the maintenance procedure.

definition_en: component used to damp pressure pulsations or protect instruments in hydraulic service
definition_es: componente usado para amortiguar pulsaciones y proteger instrumentos
example_en: Check the snubber if the pressure indication is unstable.

definition_en: underlying cause that explains why a fault occurred
definition_es: causa subyacente que explica por qué ocurrió una falla
example_en: Identify the probable root cause and location of the hydraulic fault.
